title: Route models and compress context
brief: Every task receives the full repository history and the most expensive model. Costs grow while key constraints still disappear from the handoff.
acceptance: Correctness comes before efficiency: a cheaper route or shorter handoff that drops a current constraint is not an improvement.
Routine work stays on an appropriate approved stage and ambiguous work escalates with a reason.
Calls, retries and context/output limits stay within the published limits (see Graded format in README.md).
